text_to_image_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create the requested production spatial reference for an existing fictional Rian Thalys story location. Image 1 locks the connected spatial geometry; later images lock the existing visual appearance. Tidal gate at dawn, limestone cavern coast, sea channel at LEFT, broad white marble stair flight at RIGHT ascending away from camera to a shell-topped pointed palace arch, blue banners, warm gold lamps, rocky seawater edge. Keep this exact stair/arch/sea relationship. Asset type: ONE TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN 2D FLOOR/SITE PLAN viewed exactly vertically, no perspective, no roof. Refined architectural linework on ivory background; walls/rock outlines dark gray, walkable dry surfaces pale ivory, water translucent pale turquoise, fixed furniture/obstacles shown as exact footprint symbols. Copy the 3D layout anchors exactly, do not mirror. Depict door openings and fixed circulation clearly. Sparse short English labels to identify main zones, no numerical dimensions, no scale claims, no arbitrary compass. One plan only filling portrait 9:16 page. For reef/cave draw natural terrain channel and rock/coral footprints; for bridge show straight bridge over water; no invented rooms or doors. This is a film set spatial concept plan, not a measured construction plan. Preserve exact existing anchors and materials. Unseen surfaces minimally completed, no new story props. Clear legible professional reference; no watermark.
